### Properties

#### VariableScope

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Execution.VariableScope VariableScope { get; set; }
```

Optional variable scope for substituting @variable references in WHERE conditions with literal values before FetchXML transpilation.


#### TdsQueryExecutor

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.Query.ITdsQueryExecutor TdsQueryExecutor { get; set; }
```

The TDS query executor for direct SQL execution (Phase 3.5). Required when P:PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanOptions.UseTdsEndpoint is true.


#### EnablePrefetch

```text
System.Boolean EnablePrefetch { get; set; }
```

Whether to wrap scan nodes with PrefetchScanNode for page-ahead buffering. Default false (opt-in).


#### ExplainOnly

```text
System.Boolean ExplainOnly { get; set; }
```

If true, build plan for explanation only — don&#x27;t execute.


#### ForceClientAggregation

```text
System.Boolean ForceClientAggregation { get; set; }
```

When true, forces client-side hash grouping instead of Dataverse-side aggregation. Set by the -- ppds:HASH_GROUP query hint.


#### IncludeCount

```text
System.Boolean IncludeCount { get; set; }
```

Whether to include total record count in the result.


#### NoLock

```text
System.Boolean NoLock { get; set; }
```

When true, signals FetchXmlScanNode to inject no-lock=&quot;true&quot; into FetchXML. Set by the -- ppds:NOLOCK query hint.


#### UseTdsEndpoint

```text
System.Boolean UseTdsEndpoint { get; set; }
```

Whether to use the TDS Endpoint (Phase 3.5).


#### CteBindings

```text
System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2<System.String,PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.IQueryPlanNode> CteBindings { get; set; }
```

CTE name-to-node bindings for recursive CTE planning. When the planner encounters a table matching a CTE name in this dictionary, it returns the bound node instead of generating FetchXML.


#### RemoteExecutorFactory

```text
System.Func`2<System.String,PPDS.Dataverse.Query.IQueryExecutor> RemoteExecutorFactory { get; set; }
```

Factory for creating IQueryExecutor instances for remote environments. Takes a profile label (e.g., &quot;UAT&quot;), returns an IQueryExecutor for that environment, or null if the label is not found. Combines profile resolution and executor creation. Set by the caller.


#### AggregateRecordLimit

```text
System.Int32 AggregateRecordLimit { get; set; }
```

Maximum records per partition for aggregate partitioning. Default is 40,000 to stay safely below the Dataverse 50K AggregateQueryRecordLimit.


#### MaxRecordsPerPartition

```text
System.Int32 MaxRecordsPerPartition { get; set; }
```

Maximum records per partition. Default is 40,000 to provide headroom below the 50K limit.


#### PoolCapacity

```text
System.Int32 PoolCapacity { get; set; }
```

Pool capacity from pool.GetTotalRecommendedParallelism().


#### PrefetchBufferSize

```text
System.Int32 PrefetchBufferSize { get; set; }
```

Number of rows to buffer ahead for prefetch. Default 5000 (~3 FetchXML pages).


#### MaxDate

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.DateTime> MaxDate { get; set; }
```

Latest createdon date in the target entity. Required for aggregate partitioning.


#### MinDate

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.DateTime> MinDate { get; set; }
```

Earliest createdon date in the target entity. Required for aggregate partitioning.


#### DmlRowCap

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> DmlRowCap { get; set; }
```

Row cap for DML operations. null = unlimited, default comes from DmlSafetyGuard (10,000).


#### MaxRows

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> MaxRows { get; set; }
```

Global row limit, if any.


#### PageNumber

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> PageNumber { get; set; }
```

Page number for caller-controlled paging (1-based). When set, the plan fetches only this single page instead of auto-paging.


#### EstimatedRecordCount

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int64> EstimatedRecordCount { get; set; }
```

Estimated total record count for the query&#x27;s entity. When set for aggregate queries and the count exceeds P:PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanOptions.AggregateRecordLimit, the planner partitions the query by date range and executes partitions in parallel across the connection pool. Obtained from PPDS.Dataverse.Query.IQueryExecutor.GetTotalRecordCountAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken) by the caller.


#### OriginalSql

```text
System.String OriginalSql { get; set; }
```

The original SQL text, needed for TDS Endpoint routing. When P:PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanOptions.UseTdsEndpoint is true, this SQL is passed directly to the TDS Endpoint instead of being transpiled to FetchXML.


#### PagingCookie

```text
System.String PagingCookie { get; set; }
```

Paging cookie from a previous result for continuation. Used with P:PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.QueryPlanOptions.PageNumber for caller-controlled paging.
